content: Each call site of a custom hook gets its own independent state instance by default -- extracting shared business logic into a hook does NOT create shared state across screens/components unless the hook itself reads/writes a module-level variable (singleton) or context. This project already uses module-level singletons (useRP.js globalRP, useProgress.js _pending) deliberately; new extracted hooks must not accidentally introduce a new one, and existing ones must be preserved untouched with their reset-on-signout guards intact.
